_meta.description: Single source of truth for metadata colors across all InstaNovoFM notebooks. Nature Methods style: pastel, colorblind-safe (adapted from ColorBrewer Set2 + Wong CB-safe palette).
_meta.neutral_note: Uniform fill used for categorical fields that should NOT be color-encoded (PTMs, diseases, tissue, cell_type). Same treatment as the PTM figure in notebook 1.

_organism_full_note: Binomial names as they appear in the UMAP parquet, for figure_3. The 'organism' block above holds figure_1's abbreviated labels ('H. sapiens') and cannot be reused here: its org_group() mapper folds 'Homo sapiens; Arabidopsis thaliana' into 'H. sapiens', silently merging a multi-species sample into human. Mixed samples get their own key instead. Colours are the 12 measured for maximum CVD separation (worst pair dE 5.2); anything outside these keys is grey 'other'.
_project_note: The 12 largest projects in the UMAP sample. 78 exist; 12 is the ceiling for colours a reader can still tell apart, so the rest fall to grey 'other'.
_modification_note: PTM classes as they appear in umap_coordinates.parquet's modification_class. 'Unmodified' takes the neutral grey on purpose: it is the absence of a PTM and covers 72% of spectra, so giving it a hue would paint the whole embedding one colour.
_chem_label_note: Labelling strategy from search_quant, the authoritative field: 'precursor' is label-free quantification, 'TMT' is isobaric labelling. Deriving this from UniMod accessions in modification_types instead catches only 113 of the 3,610 labelled spectra (97% miss), because a fixed TMT modification is often not written per spectrum. The accessions are still used to rescue the 57 spectra search_quant files as 'precursor' but that carry iTRAQ or SILAC, which it has no category for. 'Label-free' is neutral grey: it is 96% of spectra and would otherwise swamp the plot.
_tier_note: Ordinal ramp (tiers are nested and ordered, so one hue with monotone lightness — never categorical hues). LCFM/MCFM/HCFM pass the ordinal checks on a white surface: monotone L, adjacent dL >= 0.06, light end 2.26:1, hue spread 13 deg. ACFM is a context-only step, not drawn as a mark; a 4-step drawn ramp would need #1F4E79 appended at the dark end instead.
_pipeline_note: Storage stages in data/foundational.txt. The four tiers are NOT re-coloured here: they reuse the tier block above, because colour follows the entity across the whole figure set. Only raw and mzML are new entities, and they are pre-model source formats rather than confidence tiers, so they take neutral greys — the hue change is what marks them as a different kind of thing.
